# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 42 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 42 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_042_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 11, Part 1 — How to Spot a False Prophet

**42:1** He showed me a group of men sitting on a bench and one man seated apart in a chair. "Do you see those men on the bench?" he asked me. "Yes, lord," I said. "Those are the faithful," he told me. "The man in the chair is a false prophet who is corrupting the understanding of God's servants — specifically the double-minded ones, not the genuinely faithful."

**42:2** "These double-minded people go to him like they're consulting a fortune-teller, asking what's going to happen to them. That false prophet has no divine Spirit in him whatsoever, yet he answers their questions according to what they want to hear — he tells them what their corrupt hearts are craving. He's hollow inside, so he gives hollow answers to hollow people. He just says whatever he's asked, speaking from the emptiness of his own heart. Sometimes, by accident, he gets something right — because the devil helps him do that deliberately, making enough of his predictions come true to boost his confidence and draw in more of the double-minded, leading them further and further astray."

**42:3** "Those who are firmly grounded in faith don't consult him at all — they know there's nothing true in him. The thing is, a spirit that genuinely comes from God never needs to be consulted or asked questions. Because it carries God's power, it speaks on its own, speaking what God wants said. So here's how it works: when someone who has the divine Spirit enters an assembly of righteous, Spirit-trusting believers and the whole group prays together, the angel of the prophetic Spirit who rests on that person fills them up, and that person — now full of the Holy Spirit — speaks to the congregation whatever the Lord wills."

**42:4** "That is how you recognize the divine Spirit — it shows itself in that setting. Whatever the divine Spirit has the power to say comes from the Lord. So pay attention: understand the difference between the Spirit that comes from God and the false spirit, so that you can trust the true Spirit and not be deceived by the false one."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the community discernment dynamic of Hermas's prophetic teaching.*
